Before you write

  • 1Bug? Tell us your device, browser, and what you tapped just before it broke. A screenshot helps enormously.
  • 2Online issue? Mention the mode (Quick Match, Custom Room, Rondo) and roughly when it happened.
  • 3Idea? One paragraph on the idea, one on why it would make the game better.

Or just play another match.

Sometimes the best feedback is a rematch.
